headline: Trump and Mike Johnson think the AI industry is overreacting
summary: AI leaders like Amodei, Altman, and Musk advocate slowing AI development. They support 'pacing the frontier' amid rapid advancements. Trump and Mike Johnson believe the industry is overreacting to these concerns.

headline: Apple is reportedly working on iPhone game controllers
summary: Apple is rumored to be developing two game controllers for iPhone devices. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman suggests they will be sold under the Beats brand. macOS code references also indicate first-party controller development.

headline: The Units’ Digital Stimulation is synthpunk perfection
summary: Review highlights The Units' 'Digital Stimulation' as synthpunk excellence. The band was discovered through the 'No Dogs in Space' podcast. It perfectly blends punk rock and synthesizers.

headline: Waymo pulls over, calls cops on riders with a ghost gun
summary: A Waymo robotaxi stopped and alerted police about its passengers. Two juveniles in the self-driving car were arrested in San Francisco. They were found to be in possession of a loaded AR-style ghost gun.

headline: The Last of Us Part 2 Multiplayer Mod Cancelled at Sony’s Request
summary: A PvP multiplayer mod for 'The Last of Us Part 2' on PC has been cancelled. Sony Interactive Entertainment contacted the mod maker. Sony requested the project not be released publicly.

headline: Lanterns Season 1, Episode 5 Review & Recap: "Lights Out"
summary: 'Lanterns' Episode 5, titled 'Lights Out', concludes its 2016 storyline. The situation in Rushville escalates into an all-out war. Read the full review to catch up on the action.

headline: New Batman: Part 2 Set Photos Hint at the Court of Owls
summary: New set photos from 'The Batman: Part II' in London have emerged. The images fuel rumors about the inclusion of the Court of Owls. This secret cabal of Gotham elites may feature in the upcoming movie.

headline: This Popular RM1 CD Player Art Frame on Kickstarter Brings Back the Nostalgia I Needed and Offers to Up 55% Off in Late Pledge Rewards
summary: A popular RM1 CD player art frame is gaining traction on Kickstarter. It taps into nostalgia for physical music formats. Late pledges offer up to 55% off for backers.

headline: Committee calls for bill to address AI threat to human rights
summary: A cross-party parliamentary group urges new legislation for AI. They identify human rights risks not covered by current laws. The committee seeks a bill to address potential AI threats.

headline: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
summary: Russia struck a Ukrainian train on the Polish border. The attack occurred shortly after Boris Johnson and European officials departed. Johnson condemned Putin's 'warped logic' for hitting a stationary target.

headline: Watch: Why a Russian strike on train near Ukraine-Poland border could mark an escalation
summary: A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border. No casualties were reported despite the attack. The incident, following Boris Johnson's visit, could signify an escalation.

headline: 'Culture shift' needed in how UK does business, PM urges
summary: The UK Prime Minister calls for a 'culture shift' in business practices. He advocates government support for risk-takers. Critics highlight his government's role in increasing business costs.
